format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-search id="named" data-probe for="ext" shortcut=""></sf-search><button id="ext" type="button">Найти</button>

<script>document.querySelectorAll('sf-search[data-probe]').forEach((el) => { el.provider = (query) => { const q = query.toLowerCase(); const items = [{id:'buttons',group:'pages',title:'Кнопки',path:'Компоненты › Действия',href:'#buttons',icon:'smart_button'},{id:'table',group:'pages',title:'Таблица в рамке',path:'Утилиты › Таблицы',href:'#table',icon:'table'},{id:'sf-button',group:'components',title:'sf-button',path:'Смарт-компонент',text:'кнопка',href:'#sf-button',icon:'widgets'},{id:'theme',group:'actions',title:'Сменить тему',path:'Команда',action:'theme',icon:'contrast',shortcut:'⇧⌘L'}]; const found = q ? items.filter((i) => (i.title + ' ' + (i.text || '')).toLowerCase().includes(q)) : items.filter((i) => i.action); return {groups:[{id:'pages',label:'Страницы'},{id:'components',label:'Компоненты'},{id:'actions',label:'Действия'}], items: found, popular:['таблица','кнопка']}; }; });</script>

probes.title: the page's trigger says it opens a dialog and which keys open it

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#t'); return t.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'dialog' && t.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && /K/.test(t.getAttribute('aria-keyshortcuts') || '') && document.querySelector('#ext').getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'dialog'; })()

probes.title: the trigger opens the window: a modal dialog, focus in its field, the page locked
probes.covers: actions.open, events.open, events.opened, layer.locks-page, host-states data-open

steps.check: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('.sf-search-window'); return w && w.getAttribute('role') === 'dialog' && w.getAttribute('aria-modal') === 'true' && w.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Поиск по сайту' && document.activeElement === document.querySelector('.sf-search-input') && document.querySelector('#s').getAttribute('data-open') === 'true' && document.documentElement.style.overflow === 'hidden' && document.querySelector('#t').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'; })()

probes.title: Command/Control+K opens the window from anywhere; / does not from a text field
typing asks the provider: grouped results, the match marked, the first row selected

steps.script: (async () => { const i = document.querySelector('.sf-search-input'); i.value = "кноп"; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.sf-search-row'); const mark = document.querySelector('.sf-search-row mark'); return rows.length === 2 && mark && mark.textContent === 'Кноп' && rows[0].getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' && document.querySelector('.sf-search-input').getAttribute('aria-activedescendant') === rows[0].id && document.querySelectorAll('.sf-search-scope').length === 3; })()
